# Pour Score

> Pour Score is a latte art coach app for home baristas. It guides each pour step by step, shows the angle of your jug live, and takes you from your first heart to a swan. It is in early access, with a UK launch on the App Store planned. For adults (18+).

## What it does

- Guided pours: a path draws itself across the cup in time with the pour, at full, half or quarter speed.
- Live tilt reading: the phone shows the angle of the jug or cup in degrees and turns green when you are in range for that phase.
- Dry rehearsal: practise the hand movement with an empty jug, so no milk is wasted.
- Perfect your milk: short lessons on aeration, incorporation, and how to judge your milk by height and sound.
- Nine latte art patterns, in the order the app teaches them: monk's head, heart, tulip, rippled heart, rosetta, stacked tulip, swan, etched animals and stacked rosetta.
- Photo scoring: take a photo of your pour and get a star score. The score is made by an AI service, so treat it as coaching, not a verdict: it can be wrong. The photo is sent for scoring only after you agree, and any pour can be logged without a score.
- Pour log with a photo, a streak and five tiers: Beginner, Home Pourer, Confident, Café Ready and Barista. Tiers unlock as you log pours.
- Coaching that fits your kit: set up your coffee station once and the guide fits your jug and cup.

## What it is not

Pour Score is not a video course, a qualification or a live class, and it does not cover espresso extraction or running a café bar. It is a practice coach for milk and latte art at home. It is also not a coffee-review, drink-rating or beer app, and it has no link to other apps that share part of its name. The only official site is pourscoreapp.com.

## Who it is for

Adults (18+) with an espresso machine and a jug of milk, from new machine owners pouring a first heart to home baristas working on rosettas and swans.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pourscoreapp.com/): what Pour Score is and how it works
- [Latte art patterns](https://pourscoreapp.com/latte-art-patterns/): the nine patterns in learning order, each with its tier
- [Learn latte art at home](https://pourscoreapp.com/learn-latte-art/): a guide for the home barista: kit, typical milk per drink, where to start, practice and common questions. States plainly that Pour Score is not a course, qualification or live class
- [Questions answered](https://pourscoreapp.com/faq/): short answers on learning latte art at home, practising without wasting milk, steaming milk, which pattern to learn first, and course or app
- [Latte art tips](https://pourscoreapp.com/tips/): one short, practical tip a week for the home barista, each answering a single question such as why a heart has a fat line through it
- [Support](https://pourscoreapp.com/support/): how to contact Pour Score, report a security problem and delete your account
- [Features](https://pourscoreapp.com/features/): guided pours, live tilt, dry rehearsal, milk lessons, progress and streaks
- [Privacy Policy](https://pourscoreapp.com/privacy/)

## Latest tips

- [Bubbly or Thin? How to Read Your Milk Before You Pour](https://pourscoreapp.com/tips/bubbly-or-thin-how-to-read-your-milk-before-you-pour/): Bubbly foam and thin milk fail in different ways. Here's how to tell which one you've got before you pour, and what to change on the next jug.
- [How Long Does It Take to Learn Latte Art at Home?](https://pourscoreapp.com/tips/how-long-does-it-take-to-learn-latte-art-at-home/): There's no honest number of weeks. Here's what actually decides how fast you get a readable pattern, and how to practise so you keep moving.
- [How to Steam Milk for Latte Art at Home](https://pourscoreapp.com/tips/how-to-steam-milk-for-latte-art-at-home/): Steaming milk for latte art comes down to two steps: make tiny bubbles early, then split them down until the milk pours like a liquid.
- [Three Ways to Practise Latte Art Without Wasting Milk](https://pourscoreapp.com/tips/practise-latte-art-without-wasting-milk/): You don't need a fridge full of milk to get better at latte art. Three ways to practise the movement, the rhythm and the pour with little or none.
- [Why Your Latte Art Heart Has a Fat Line Through It](https://pourscoreapp.com/tips/fat-line-through-latte-art-heart/): A thick line down the middle of a latte art heart has one cause. Here is what causes it and how to draw a thin, straight line instead.
- [Latte Art Course or an App? How to Choose](https://pourscoreapp.com/tips/latte-art-course-or-an-app/): Thinking about an online latte art course? Here is what a course gives you, what an app gives you, and how to choose if you practise at home.
